story:
2025 was a hard year. After 12 days of hunting hard and dealing with every non-resident imaginable, I ended the season with an intact tag. 

 The first day of the hunt started out hot. We had a herd bull budgling and checking cows right out of the gate.  

We worked inside a 100 yards but a Cow and a calf came over the ridge and pulled the pull up the valley. He quit bugling so we continued on. 

 Through out the day we called in a couple of spikes taht came close to offering a shot and one more cow but that ended the day. 

The next day I had to come home to present to Senior leadership so it was back up Wednesday. We had a couple of bugles but it was still a early seaso vibe. I got into one of my favorite spots and decided to just hang out for a little bit. After a few minutes and couple of Cow/Calf groups started feeding around us. A lone cow joined the group a few minutes after that. We softly cow called a couple of times and the lone cow came over to check us out. She came into 30 yards and I was able to make a perfect shot
